meta.title: dsh-desktop-restart
meta.description: Adds Reload UI and Restart App buttons at the sidebar foot. Reload re-loads the interface and client plugins only, so edits to client buttons and styles show up immediately; Restart relaunches the whole DeepSeek Harness desktop app together with its Host, which is what edits to Host routes and index.js require. It removes the manual refresh / manual close-and-reopen loop when iterating on a plugin: the two actions sit in the sidebar and work in one click. Fully supported on Windows desktop only; the restart runs from a watchdog outside the Chromium job so killing the app does not kill the watchdog, no application-level shortcut is registered, and under plain dsh web the restart route answers 409 while the button degrades to a page reload. Limitations: restart is a hard kill, so a running Agent turn is interrupted (session history is unaffected), and panels open before the restart must be reopened afterwards.
